verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, not a data-hosting or SaaS product, so letting users choose a data storage region is a category error for this kind of product. Its privacy practice advises clients on compliance, and its Clerky partnership covers formation workflows. Neither shows the firm itself offering user-selectable data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
